rows.definition: Per-client map of inferred cached prompt tokens held by the gateway metrics snapshot when a provider does not report cache reads.
rows.distinction: Gateway-side inference bookkeeping; it is not the provider-reported CachedPromptTokens field and not engine KV-cache telemetry.

rows.definition: Byte footprint of resident KV tensors as reported by the device-spine gauge and the componentized memory plan.
rows.distinction: Raw KV storage byte count; it is not vCache page-table virtualization accounting and not the MALL Infinity Cache size knobs.

rows.definition: llama.cpp-shaped timings.cache_n counter recording how many prompt tokens were served from cache, tracked in the gateway perf ledger.
rows.distinction: Token count of cache-served prompts; it is not the byte footprint (KVCacheBytes), not the external kvcached management tool, and not the Q8_0 KV module.

rows.definition: Source module internal/model/kvcache_q8.go implementing the Q8_0 quantized KV cache realization (#12981) with its KVPackedRow int8-code scheme.
rows.distinction: The quantization module cited in provenance comments; it is not the serve-time KV precision policy selector, not the external kvcached tool, and not the generic KV cache concept.

rows.definition: Continuous-batcher admission flag marking a request whose KV cache remains resident in UMA between turns instead of being evicted.
rows.distinction: Residency decision flag on an admission record; it is not the byte cap MaxKVCacheBytes and not an engine-reported usage fraction.

rows.definition: Unitless fraction (0..1) of engine KV cache in use, accumulated by the vLLM, SGLang and MLX engine adapters from their scrapes.
rows.distinction: Normalized engine-adapter fraction; it is not the percent-typed field KVCacheUsagePct (MLX) and not the vLLM wire label kv_cache_usage_perc.

rows.definition: Percent of KV cache in use exposed by macobs MLX serving telemetry (json kv_cache_usage_pct).
rows.distinction: macobs percent reading for MLX serving; it is not the vLLM wire label kv_cache_usage_perc and not the normalized engine fraction KVCacheUsage.

rows.definition: vLLM wire metric label reporting KV cache usage as a percentage, ingested by the vLLM adapter and mirrored into macobs scrapes.
rows.distinction: vLLM-specific percent wire label; it is not the MLX telemetry field KVCacheUsagePct and not the unitless engine fraction KVCacheUsage.

rows.definition: Software model of the AMD Strix Halo 32 MiB on-die MALL Infinity Cache used by the strix compute package for tiling and eviction simulation.
rows.distinction: Behavioral simulator of the hardware L3; it is not the byte capacity constant StrixHaloInfinityCacheBytes and not the MB sizing knob MALLCacheSizeMB.

rows.definition: Megabyte knob (json mall_cache_size_mb, default 32) declaring the MALL Infinity Cache size consumed by roofline probes and campaign fanout contracts.
rows.distinction: Operator-visible MB sizing knob; it is not the platform byte constant StrixHaloMALLCacheSizeMB and not the software simulator MALLCacheModel.

rows.definition: Continuous-batcher configuration cap on total KV cache bytes across active slots, where 0 means unconstrained.
rows.distinction: Admission-time capacity cap; it is not the observed footprint KVCacheBytes and not the residency flag KVCacheStationary.

rows.definition: SGLang upstream python module path (python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/) cited in provenance comments behind fak's RadixKV eviction and prefix-ownership adaptations.
rows.distinction: Upstream reference path only; it is not fak's RadixKV subsystem and not the MoE expert-weight cache pkg/moecache.

rows.definition: Public pkg/moecache owning the closed routed-expert weight-cache tier vocabulary (DRAM/checkpoint/NVMe) and its typed metric envelope.
rows.distinction: MoE expert-weight cache plane; it is not the SGLang mem_cache provenance path and not the Go build cache GOCACHE.

rows.definition: Constructor instantiating the MALL Infinity Cache model with 32,768 sets and 16 ways at 32 MiB.
rows.distinction: Allocation entry point; it is not the MALLCacheModel type itself and not the MALLCacheSizeMB sizing knob.

rows.definition: macobs telemetry block carrying observed provider prefix-cache behavior collected during MLX serving scrapes.
rows.distinction: Observed-telemetry DTO; it is not the provider prefix-cache mechanism itself (prefix_cache) and not vCache calibration state.

rows.definition: SGLang upstream radix_cache.py module cited in provenance comments backing fak's RadixKV eviction and dense-prefix ownership logic.
rows.distinction: Upstream reference; it is not fak's RadixKV subsystem and not the sibling mem_cache provenance path.

rows.definition: Extend-only prefix cache enabled by the continuous batcher for hybrid models so recurrent-state prefixes are retained without full recompute.
rows.distinction: Engine-side recurrent prefix retention; it is not the SGLang radix_cache provenance path and not the V4.1 engram row cache.

rows.definition: Byte capacity of the Strix Halo Infinity Cache (L3) used by ROCm compute planning to check scratch fit.
rows.distinction: Platform byte constant; it is not the megabyte constant StrixHaloMALLCacheSizeMB and not the software model MALLCacheModel.

rows.definition: Megabyte capacity constant (32 MB) of the Strix Halo Infinity/MALL cache feeding roofline probes and qwen38campaign fanout contracts.
rows.distinction: Strix-Halo-platform MB constant; it is not the generic MALLCacheSizeMB config knob and not the byte constant StrixHaloInfinityCacheBytes.

rows.definition: agentxbench token-counts status constant "server_usage_cache_unreported" marking receipts where server usage is present but the cache breakdown is unreported.
rows.distinction: Receipt status enum member; it is not a cache mechanism and not provider-observed cache-read counters.

rows.definition: 64-byte cache-line alignment matching Zen 5 CPU MMU expectations, applied to Strix UMA pool-allocator allocations.
rows.distinction: Alignment constant; it is not the MALL cache simulator and not any Infinity Cache capacity value.

rows.definition: Local prompt-token delta not served from cache, computed as total minus cached in bench effort scoring and gateway ctx-value observation.
rows.distinction: Local prompt-side delta; it is not the provider billing field UncachedPromptTokens and not the regime input UncachedTokens.

rows.definition: Uncached-token count fed to cache regime classification (cacheobs) and effort-bench receipts.
rows.distinction: Regime/bench token count; it is not the provider billing field UncachedInputTokens, not the gateway prompt delta uncachedPrompt, and the complement of the provider hit field CachedTokens.

rows.definition: l3server shard size-tracker method refreshing the cached shard-size snapshot after shard operations and rebalance.
rows.distinction: Internal refresh seam on the size tracker; it is not a cache tier and not the LRU capacity tunable DefaultCacheSize.

rows.definition: V4.1 model method resolving per-layer KV/index execution roles, memoized across forward steps.
rows.distinction: Role-resolution memo; it is not the V4.1 engram row cache and not the published KV cache layout table.

rows.definition: Byte-oriented cache of V4.1 engram rows (Q2_K packed) read geometry-agnostic from GGUF checkpoints.
rows.distinction: Engram-row staging cache; it is not the attention-role memo v41AttentionRolesCached and not its constructor/options rows.

rows.definition: Resolver returning the published V4.1 KV cache layout for one record quant format.
rows.distinction: Single-format lookup; it is not the whole-set census accessor V41KVCacheLayouts.

rows.definition: Closed set of published V4.1 KV record layouts (fp8 first) returned for census and enumeration.
rows.distinction: Whole-set census accessor; it is not the per-format resolver V41KVCacheLayoutFor.

rows.definition: fak vcache codex-session-extract verb sanitizing a raw Codex session JSONL into vCache observed-window rows, optionally emitting a snapshot and score artifact.
rows.distinction: Codex-session extraction entrypoint; it is not the periodic vcacheobserve scrape loop and not the vcacheextract package alone.

rows.definition: ggufload functional option enabling the expert checkpoint page cache (issue #1302) on expert sources, keeping the historical ReadAt path when off.
rows.distinction: Opt-in loader flag; it is not the ExpertCheckpointPageCacheStats counters and not the FAK_EXPERT_PAGE_CACHE environment opt-in.
